prose: Kyle Denton is the head hippie in charge of potion preparation at his family company, Tippecanoe Herbs. Join us to discover the doctrine of signatures in the patterns of plants, to know through consciousness the virtues of vegetation without the need to memorize Latin names and categories.
ext: We talk about Kyle's philosophy for herbal blends and different dosages, astro-aromatics and the scents of Aries, using the spirit of the plant for medicine without needing the physical, and many more vital ideas.
music: InnerVerse intro theme by Conspiracy Music Guru
